agent_differential.reason: No fixed-model agent adapter, credential-free isolated agent runtime or measured usage receipt configured; this agent has already seen expected answers, so self-answering is not a controlled independent A/B.

build_preparation.reason: Owned build stopped while private cache copy was incomplete; cache recreated before successful build; no benchmark executed during preparation.

builds.reuse: immutable original baseline hashes verified before fresh execution

execution_environment.execution_comparability: both binaries executed serially in the same current host environment and CPU affinity; historical timings excluded

hardware.timings: descriptive fresh serial execution; no successful complete pair or speedup acceptance

harness.freshness: NOT_RUN; current graph evaluation only; prior watcher/manual freshness evidence not relabelled
harness.native_lane: reviewer acknowledged hold before build and measurements; no other native owner identified

controls.budget_enforcement: 50ms Linux descendant CPU/RSS sampling; kills sandbox; RSS is summed, may overshoot between samples
controls.build_control: refuse if builder active at start; sample command boundaries; operator must reserve idle host
controls.cold: empty index and HOME; OS page cache is NOT flushed
controls.cpu_affinity: first threads CPUs in inherited allowed set; all sandbox descendants inherit
controls.export: tracked code + selected package/ignore config; no install/dependency tree
controls.query_latency: CLI process + graph open + traversal; no LLM
controls.rss: GNU time max RSS KiB if available; maximum, not concurrent sum
controls.scip: NOT_RUN: external tooling absent from PATH

mcp.timing_scope: whole stdio session including startup; not per-query

tool_questions.protocol: five manifest questions in manifest order; one query_graph call each; detail=true; no retries
tool_questions.timing_scope: whole MCP session; no per-request latency or model tokens
